blocks.prompt: 5 If \(\underline{u} = 2\underline{i} + \underline{j} - 3\underline{k}\), \(\underline{v} = -\underline{i} + 4\underline{j} + 2\underline{k}\) and \(\underline{w} = 3\underline{i} - 2\underline{j} + \underline{k}\), find a unit vector parallel to \(4\underline{u} - 3\underline{v} + 2\underline{w}\).
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein do kaam ek saath hain: pehle vectors ko jor kar ek naya vector banana, phir us ka unit vector nikalna.
Diya kya hai? \(\underline{u}\), \(\underline{v}\), \(\underline{w}\).
Find kya karna hai? \(4\underline{u} - 3\underline{v} + 2\underline{w}\) ke parallel unit vector.
Plan: is vector ko \(\underline{r}\) ka naam denge, \(4\underline{u}\), \(3\underline{v}\), \(2\underline{w}\) alag alag banayenge, phir components jama/minus karenge, \(|\underline{r}|\) nikalenge aur \(\underline{r}\) ko us se divide karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\underline{u} = 2\underline{i} + \underline{j} - 3\underline{k}\), \(\underline{v} = -\underline{i} + 4\underline{j} + 2\underline{k}\), \(\underline{w} = 3\underline{i} - 2\underline{j} + \underline{k}\).
Humein find karna hai: \(\underline{r} = 4\underline{u} - 3\underline{v} + 2\underline{w}\) ke parallel unit vector.
Tareeqa: \(\underline{r}\) ko component by component banayenge, phir \(\hat{r} = \underline{r}/|\underline{r}|\). Parallel ka matlab hai same (ya bilkul ulti) direction.

Teeno vectors ko scale karein
\[4\underline{u} = 8\underline{i} + 4\underline{j} - 12\underline{k}\]
\[3\underline{v} = -3\underline{i} + 12\underline{j} + 6\underline{k}\]
\[2\underline{w} = 6\underline{i} - 4\underline{j} + 2\underline{k}\]
Kyun: Har vector ke saare components ko us ke saamne wale number se zarb diya. Alag alag likhne se aage jama minus aasaan ho jata hai.

Components jorein
\[\underline{i}: 8 - (-3) + 6 = 17\]
\[\underline{j}: 4 - 12 + (-4) = -12\]
\[\underline{k}: -12 - 6 + 2 = -16\]
\[\underline{r} = 17\underline{i} - 12\underline{j} - 16\underline{k}\]
Kyun: \(3\underline{v}\) ko minus karna hai, is liye us ke har component ka sign ulta ho kar jurta hai: \(-(-3) = +3\), \(-(12) = -12\), \(-(6) = -6\).
Dhyan dein: sirf pehle component ka sign badal kar baqi bhool jana bohot aam ghalti hai.

\(|\underline{r}|\) nikalein
\[|\underline{r}| = \sqrt{17^2 + (-12)^2 + (-16)^2}\]
\[= \sqrt{289 + 144 + 256}\]
\[= \sqrt{689}\]
Kyun: Magnitude formula lagaya. \(689 = 13 \times 53\) hai, is mein koi perfect square factor nahi, is liye \(\sqrt{689}\) aise hi rehta hai.

\(|\underline{r}|\) se divide karein
\[\hat{r} = \dfrac{17\underline{i} - 12\underline{j} - 16\underline{k}}{\sqrt{689}}\]
Kyun: Is vector ki lambai 1 hai aur direction wahi jo \(\underline{r}\) ki. Parallel vectors ulti direction mein bhi ho sakte hain, is liye \(-\hat{r}\) bhi ek parallel unit vector hai; kitab ka jawab \(\hat{r}\) wala hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{289 + 144 + 256}{689} = \dfrac{689}{689} = 1 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(\hat{r}\) ke components ke squares ka jama 1 aaya, yani lambai 1 hai. Jawab sahi hai.
blocks.final_answer:
\(\dfrac{17\underline{i} - 12\underline{j} - 16\underline{k}}{\sqrt{689}}\) (is ka negative bhi parallel hai, ulti taraf)
Pehle vector poora banaiye, phir hi lambai nikaliye.
